posts.title: Fix files that cannot be deleted in Nextcloud
posts.description: I have been happily enjoying my self-hosted Nextcloud installation on an ancient Raspberry Pi for a few months. It's been mostly without issue, but I have noticed that sometimes it struggles with deleting files or with synchronising files that you delete locally (i.e. it somehow isn't aware of the fact that a file has been deleted).
